name: stay-picker

frames.best_why: Stay 12 to 17 lit as one pill, with 5 nights, a $890 total and an active Reserve button.

tagline: Pick check-in and check-out on a price-per-night calendar.
summary: A booking calendar for choosing a stay. Each night shows its price, sold-out nights are hatched, and the chosen range becomes one pill with a running total and a Reserve button.
appearance: A dark rounded calendar card. A month heading with two chevrons sits above a Mo-Su grid where each day number carries a tiny nightly price, and sold-out days are hatched and struck through. Below the grid a status line sits over a Total figure and a Reserve pill.
behaviour: Clicking a night starts a stay and a second click ends it, with the range drawn as one pill that wraps across week rows. Hovering previews the end night, sold-out nights are refused, and Reserve turns green once booked.
demo_content: November 2026 with nightly prices like 158 and 165, and a stay from Nov 12 to Nov 17 for $890.
search_phrases: pick check in and check out dates
use_when: A booking flow needs guests to pick a stay while seeing nightly prices and unavailable nights.
avoid_when: It shows one month at a time and has no text input, so far-off or flexible dates are slow to reach.
customise: Month, a nightly price and availability function, minimum nights, currency and a reserve callback are props; colours and the row height are fixed in the source.
weight_why: A month grid of buttons with a few layout animations; nothing runs when idle.

a11y.note: Arrow keys move between days and Enter picks, with prices and pressed state announced; the range pill itself is decorative.

props.name: onReserve
props.type: (stay: { checkIn: string; checkOut: string; total: number }) => void

props.default: "group absolute flex flex-col items-center justify-center ou

issues: Nightly prices are very small and low contrast under each day number.
polish_why: Clear range pill across weeks, meaningful sold-out hatching and a tidy total footer.
